title: Lazy-Loaded Images Broken in Viewport — /products on 4K (lamartina.fynd.io)
description: 3 of 32 lazy-loaded images that are within the visible viewport at 4K (2160px tall) failed to load. Because the 4K viewport is much taller than standard displays, more images are "above the fold" but the lazy loading threshold may not account for this. Broken images: 1. "QRh_kwy0f-Home.png?dpr=1" at y=0px — 0x0px — not loaded 2. "_7Cid-lB7-Collections.png?dpr=1" at y=0px — 0x0px — not loaded 3. "Emn-_d_tI-La-Martina.jpeg?dpr=1" at y=0px — 0x0px — not loaded
steps: 1. Open https://lamartina.fynd.io/products on a 4K display (3840x2160) or use DevTools device emulation 2. Wait for the page to fully load (5+ seconds) 3. Observe blank/missing image placeholders within the visible viewport 4. These images have loading="lazy" but are in the viewport and should have loaded Broken images: 1. "QRh_kwy0f-Home.png?dpr=1" at y=0px — 0x0px — not loaded 2. "_7Cid-lB7-Collections.png?dpr=1" at y=0px — 0x0px — not loaded 3. "Emn-_d_tI-La-Martina.jpeg?dpr=1" at y=0px — 0x0px — not loaded
